notes: Combined 10-K of American States Water Company and its subsidiary Southern California Water Company (CIK 92116, later Golden State Water). Pre-2003 numbering: Item 14 is exhibits. Contents entries use 'Item N:' and are not labeled; body headings mix 'ITEM 1.' and 'ITEM 2 -'. Item 7A says the disclosure is not applicable; Items 10-13 incorporate the proxy statement. Item 14 says the required schedules appear 'at the conclusion of this Item', so it runs through the auditors' report on the supplemental schedule and Schedule I to SIGNATURES.
